column1: #notes label(help) yukon automation arm: a small fort for the default start (research/automation-arm.md)
Every level section uses the access stair as its start cursor. automation.lua stair_site picks it:
open surface floor whose footprint on the three soil levels below is dry non-aquifer soil.
/stair_top on the surface; /farm_dig one level down; /rooms_dig two down; /dorm2_dig three down.
Once a level is dug: /farm_build; quickfort orders + run /rooms_build then /rooms_zone; same for dorm2.
/still and /kitchen take a workshop centre as the cursor.
#dig label(stair_top) start(12;3;access stair) down stair on the surface
#dig label(farm_dig) start(12;3;access stair) up-down stair and an 11x3 farm room to its east
#dig label(rooms_dig) start(12;3;access stair) up-down stair with an 11x3 dormitory east and a 5x3 dining room west
#dig label(dorm2_dig) start(12;3;access stair) up stair and a second 11x3 dormitory east
#build label(farm_build) start(12;3;access stair) three 3x3 farm plots
#build label(rooms_build) start(12;3;access stair) 22 dormitory beds plus 3 tables and 3 chairs in the dining room
#zone label(rooms_zone) start(12;3;access stair) dormitory and dining hall zones
#zone label(dorm2_zone) start(12;3;access stair) second dormitory zone
